Accel-KKR's Avocet Bidco to Buy Eleco in $261 Million Deal
By Andrea Figueras
Accel-KKR's Avocet Bidco said it reached an agreement to buy U.K. software provider Eleco for 192.4 million pounds, or $260.7 million, including debt.

The private-equity firm's  investment vehicle said Thursday that the acquisition, expected to complete during or before the first quarter of next year, is conditional on, among other things, the approval by the majority of Eleco shareholders.
Under the terms of the deal, each Eleco shareholder would receive 235 pence in cash for each share held, representing a 75% premium to yesterday's closing price of 134.5 pence.
The Eleco board believes that the deal will place the company in a better position to grow the business for the benefit of customers and staff, Eleco Chairman Mark Castle said.
Shareholders representing 45% of Eleco shares are supportive of the transaction, Avocet Bidco said.
